description: This file defines functions and include guards for managing SSL certificate objects within a TLS/SSL library. It includes function declarations for creating and freeing certificate objects, with references to SSL types and external symbol definitions.

methods.name: __ssl_cert_new
methods.description: Creates a new SSL certificate object based on the provided certification and optional RNG context.

methods.name: ssl_cert_new
methods.description: Creates a new SSL certificate object with default parameters, requiring an RNG context.

methods.name: ssl_cert_free
methods.description: Frees the allocated SSL certificate object.
